newsitem.title: CHINA: Daewoo jv in China luxury bus deals.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo jv in China luxury bus deals.

text.p: A Chinese joint venture company half-owned by South Korea's Daewoo Corp is planning to buy a large number of luxury buses from another Daewoo-invested venture in south China, company officials said on Tuesday.

Newly founded Jiyu Superhighway Transportation Co Ltd based in eastern China's Shandong province had already bought 10 buses from Guilin Daewoo Bus Co Ltd in southern Guangxi province, said an official from Daewoo's representative office in Beijing.
Daewoo Corp, the trading unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, holds a 60 percent stake in the Guilin venture, which had invested capital of $250 million, the official said.

The Shandong transport firm, in which Daewoo had a 50 percent stake, hoped to be operating 30 of the Guilin venture's buses by the end of 1997, he said. Each bus was worth one million yuan ($120,000). The official Xinhua news agency on Tuesday reported that Jiyu Superhighway Transportation intended to buy a total of 500 of the Guilin luxury buses, but an official of the venture described that figure as no more than a long-term target.
Daewoo Corp has another express bus service joint venture in the southwestern province of Sichuan.
